name: Spacecraft & stations
blurb: Crewed vehicles and orbiting stations. The atmosphere is assumed to be close to Earth air.

name: Lunar base
blurb: Expected air of 30% O₂ or more at 10.2 psi or less. That is over 40% more oxygen than Earth air, so materials burn much more readily.

name: Mars base
blurb: A surface base on Mars. Its atmosphere is not defined yet, so the window shown is a placeholder.

name: Pressurized rover
blurb: Pressurized rovers are expected to run at the same intermediate pressure and oxygen level as the Moon base.
